summary: Platform atop a garage in Beaverhead County, MT; built 1930 per NHLR (1930s per its description); still there on private property.

facts.design: Platform atop a garage, not a tower
facts.status_note: Only the platform on top of a garage is still there, and it is on private property.

access.note: Now on private property, per the NHLR and firelookout.com.

events.note: NHLR Built field gives 1930; its description says sometime in the 1930s

evidence.supports: description: built sometime in the 1930s; platform atop garage still there; now on private property
evidence.quote: Built sometime in the 1930s, this platform atop garage is still there but is now on private property.

evidence.supports: 1930s; platform atop garage; still there; now private property
evidence.quote: 1930s: platform atop garage. Still there. Now private property.

evidence.supports: location Beaverhead County, Montana; administered by private property

corrections.why: Both the NHLR and firelookout.com say the platform atop the garage is still there, on private property. The record's gone status does not match the sources.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The NHLR Built field gives 1930, but its description says the platform was built sometime in the 1930s, and firelookout.com also says 1930s. The record keeps 1930 from the Built field; the exact year is not confirmed.

notes_for_editor: Two short sources only; no staffing, fire or height record found. WebSearch returned only Wyoming's Jackson Lake Ranger Station (NRHP) and an unrelated Beaverhead NF catalog entry, so neither is used. The montanalookouts page lists the site under a Beaverhead NF section (3S-13W-18) while the NHLR says private property; the station may have been on Forest land historically, but this is unverified. Record agency 'Private Property' is the NHLR administered-by field, not an agency, so facts.agency is omitted; the editor may want the field changed. firelookout.org's Montana list tags it 'Rooftop Abandoned'.
